# serverroom_plan_os (Data Source)

The operating systems a plan installs, by the exact names serverroom_server_os takes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "serverroom_plan_os" "m710x" {
  plan = "M710x"
}

output "installable" {
  value = data.serverroom_plan_os.m710x.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plan` (String) Plan code, e.g. "M710x" (the plan attribute of serverroom_servers).

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String)
